hypothesis: Screen the startle radius against current hunter density before tuning herd stores; then, at the selected radius, screen herd count, size, radius, speed, grazing duration and assimilation.
prediction:
Stage 1 (16 seeds x 200000 ticks, policy live): compare startle radii 200, 400, 700 and 1000 with defaults using eval.herd_grazed_share, eval.herd_stampede_rate and eval.predators_at_end. Expect 200 to produce fewer stampedes and more grazing than 1000; the chosen radius is the one that permits grazing without losing the stampede scene. Stage 2 is conditional on Stage 1 and uses the chosen radius: herdCount 2/4/6, herdSize 6/10, herdRadius 60/90, herdRunSpeed 5/7.5, herdGrazeTicks 15/60 and herdAssimilation 0.15/0.5. Compare eval.dodge_skill and eval.trampled_share for Luck is not skill, and eval.herd_animals and eval.herd_grazed_share for Boom and bust. Predictions are qualitative until the runs exist.

note: Completed for Megafauna Phase 1 T14 after the user released the CPU. Stage 1 (16 seeds) and Stage 2 (8 seeds) results, including per-arm Phase 1 gate counts, are recorded in evals/screens/results/herds/phase1-gate.md; Stage 2 grid is evals/screens/herds-stage2.grid.json. The best tested candidate was herdStartleRadius 200 plus herdCount 6. A separate 16-seed confirmation produced positive herd_animals and herd_grazed_share on 16/16 seeds, but herd_carcass_meal_share on only 10/16, so it misses the plan’s 12/16 gate. Candidate config: evals/experiments/E76-best-config.json. Power analysis of the 64-seed candidate report is recorded in evals/experiments/E76-power.json (source report evals/screens/results/herds/E76-power-64.report.json): carcass meal share, role carcass shares, gap crossings, stampede rate and trampled share are weak or sparse detectors at n=16/32; herd presence and grazing share are better powered. The screen’s original generic scorecard did not include the phase-specific carcass-meal gate; that omission is corrected in the targets and transparent gate table. Exploratory follow-up (not registered in the original E76 grid): carcassTicks 12000 at radius 200/count 6 yielded carcass meals 6/8 (mean 0.004615) versus the registered count-6 stage-2 arm at 5/8 (mean 0.002305); see /tmp/mega-e76-carcass12000-8.report.json and /tmp/mega-e76-best-8.report.json. These 8-seed reports generated the extension hypothesis only and are not confirmatory. The matched 16-seed confirmation is preregistered in evals/screens/herds-carcass-duration.grid.json. Registered extension result (16 seeds x 200000 ticks, policy live, exact E76 seed set) is recorded in evals/screens/results/herds-carcass-duration/. With carcass lifetime 12000, herd animals and grazing were positive on 16/16, carcass meals on 11/16 (mean 0.005702); the matched 6000-tick reference had carcass meals on 10/16 (mean 0.002719). The extension improves meal share but still misses the 12/16 gate by one seed; predators at end fell from 2/16 to 0/16. This does not pass the original 12/16 carcass target or a survival gate. By explicit user direction, T15 adopts the measured improvement (mean carcass meal share about 110% higher; positive seeds 11/16 vs 10/16) and carries the one-seed shortfall and predator-presence decline (2/16 to 0/16) into balancing. These remain diagnostics/follow-ups, not claimed passes.
